A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
FFT based OFMD out performs DWT based OFMD in terms of BER calculation.
the DWT based OFDMA system is better than FFT based OFDMA system for various channel coding and modulation techniques.

The main takeaway from our work is that
DWT-OFDMA is better suited for high data rate applications, while FFT-OFDMA is more suitable for low to medium data rate applications.

the performance of FFT-OFDM is superior to that of DWT- OFDM.
